g.text: Four QfO development-exposed ablations; initial HMM search remains on. P = refinement, C = expansion, R = reconciliation.
Ranges account for unknown means in both strata and unknown numeric-return counts; all six differences use the same joint rectangle.
Uniform without-replacement sampling and fixed pair outcomes are assumptions. These are not biological/generalization error bars.
Circles are offset descriptive observations, not expected-ratio estimates or interval centers. Failed cells/timing remain unavailable.
